incident-bot: INCIDENT 4032109876 — routing: pinned variant mismatch. Severity: P2. Trigger: spike of errors for embedding requests in eu-west, some requests returning 400/500 or chat-like responses. Pager: @sylvie-oncall

sylvie-oncall: I've got the pager, jumping in. any quick metrics?

lucas-sre: seeing ~8% error rate on /v1/embeddings for embed-alpha alias. 422s with 'incompatible input' and some successful responses are conversational text. Traces show routing to v3-chat variant.

ashley-product: Customer "SearchCo" reported search quality drop and higher latencies ~20m ago. They supplied examples where vectors are empty.

maria-cs: Confirmed SearchCo case. They lost relevance on queries across eu-west. They're asking if this is on our side.

sylvie-oncall: mitigation plan: unpin alias or reroute to v2-embed canary. who can flip the alias quickly?

kevin-ops: on it. running admin command to unpin and map embed-alpha -> v2-embed-canary.

kevin-ops: ```
# admin ops
POST /admin/aliases/unpin
payload: { "alias": "embed-alpha" }
POST /admin/aliases/update
payload: { "alias": "embed-alpha", "target": "v2-embed-canary" }
```

kevin-ops: done. alias now points to v2-embed-canary. routing checks green.

lucas-sre: error rate falling back to baseline. embeddings returning vectors again. latency normalized. looks like pin was the culprit.

ashley-product: good catch. what's the root cause? how was a chat variant pinned to an embed alias?

lucas-sre: digging — pin change came from a global config push at 03:10 UTC. pinning service accepted a v3-chat variant for alias type=embed; no validation prevented cross-kind pins.

sylvie-oncall: this is a policy validation hole. immediate action: add validation to pinning service to reject variants whose interface != alias interface.

kevin-ops: filing fix now. PR -> #4123: add server-side validation + backfill to detect existing mismatches. ETA for merge ~2h, deploy after reviews.

maria-cs: I'll send a short note to SearchCo: "we've mitigated the routing issue and are investigating root cause; we'll follow up with details and timeline for permanent fix." Anything else I should include?

ashley-product: include impact window (~18m) and that vectors returned were malformed/empty. we'll offer a follow-up postmortem.

lucas-sre: sample log for trace id abc123: ```
[2026-03-17T03:12:04Z] route: alias=embed-alpha -> variant=v3-chat
input_type=embedding, runtime_error='format mismatch', output_type=chat_message
stack: runtime/handler.go:87 -> router/pin.go:203
```

sylvie-oncall: Check other regions for similar pins. If pin push was global, sweep all aliases for type/variant mismatches.

kevin-ops: running quick audit: `/admin/pins?filter=kind_mismatch`. initial scan shows 2 other aliases with potential mismatches — isolating and will unpin if found.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: severity -> P3 (mitigated). Impact: 1 major customer (SearchCo) degraded for ~18m. Mitigation: unpinned and routed to v2-embed-canary. Next steps: merge PR #4123, run global sweep, customer comms, and postmortem.

maria-cs: I'll coordinate the customer update and follow-up meeting.

sylvie-oncall: post-incident checklist: 1) ship validation PR 2) sweep and remediate any other mismatches 3) add e2e test that pins cannot cross-kind 4) update runbook to include immediate unpin steps 5) notify infra on release gating.

ashley-product: scheduling postmortem tomorrow. tagging stakeholders. thanks all for quick response. :thumbsup:
